content.title: About
content.content: Similac NFS (Newborn Feeding System) is an infant formula designed for newborns and babies up to 6 months. The formula provides an optimal balance of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals in line with WHO recommendations and FDA standards.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Similac is one of the most widely used infant nutrition brands in the US and Europe.
The NFS formula is enriched with DHA and ARA – fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
It contains the prebiotic FOS (fructooligosaccharides) to support a healthy gut microbiome.
Each batch undergoes double quality testing: during manufacturing and before market release.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: A balanced protein and energy profile promotes normal weight gain and linear growth in infants.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA help form neural connections and support visual function.

items.title: Gut health
items.content: The FOS prebiotic encourages growth of beneficial bacteria, improving digestion.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C, E and zinc strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Easy digestibility
items.content: A special protein processing technology reduces the risk of allergic reactions.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Infants with a confirmed allergy to cow‑milk protein may react to this formula.

items.title: Incorrect reconstitution
items.content: Over‑concentrated formula can cause dehydration, while overly diluted formula may lead to nutrient deficiency.

items.title: Storage after preparation
items.content: Prepared formula left at room temperature for more than 2 hours should be discarded to prevent bacterial growth.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the specified amount of powder with freshly boiled water cooled to 37 °C. Stir thoroughly until the mixture is smooth and free of lumps.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 4 weeks. Prepared formula can be kept in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
